title: The creature they chose to lose
era: 2011 Legacy adapted to modern combat rules
matchup: Mono-Black Pox against black-white midrange creatures
story: At the start of my opponent's upkeep, The Abyss triggered with two of their creatures still on the battlefield: Black Knight and Hypnotic Specter . They chose the Knight as the target. I controlled the enchantment's ability, but I did not get to select their loss. When the trigger resolved, Black Knight was destroyed, not sacrificed, and regeneration was not available. My Mishra's Factory remained an ordinary land, not a creature, so there was no eligible target on my side for the next upkeep. Their Specter survived this turn and still threatened another attack.
review: Abyss trigger controlled by enchantment controller, target chosen by active player among their own nonartifact creatures. One chosen Black Knight destroyed without regeneration; not a sacrifice; unanimated Factory remains noncreature.
claim: representative reconstruction; not a historical match or quotation
candidateStatus: not accepted; pending ten-article checkpoint and deeper deck research
